Review.ItemLabel: UAT-1: SystemAdmin creates new Backoffice User via Add User dialog and new user signs in via magic link

Verifications.Text: Login page is displayed with the Email address input and Send sign-in link button visible.
Email address field contains "admin@acmecoffee.com".
Page displays confirmation text containing "We sent a sign-in code to".
Email inbox page loads and at least one email entry is present for admin@acmecoffee.com.
SystemAdmin (admin@acmecoffee.com) is signed in and the application is accessible.
Security Dashboard page is displayed.
USERS AND ROLE ASSIGNMENT tab is active and the user grid is visible.
Add User dialog opens and displays the Display Name input, Email input, Initial Role dropdown, Initial Organization dropdown, Create User button, and Cancel button.

Steps.Action: CLICK INPUT "Display Name" and enter "New Backoffice User"

Verifications.Text: Display Name field contains "New Backoffice User".
Email field contains "newboffice@test.local".

Steps.Action: CLICK SELECT "Initial Role" and select "Backoffice User (BackofficeUser)"

Verifications.Text: Initial Role dropdown shows "Backoffice User (BackofficeUser)" as the selected value.

Steps.Action: CLICK SELECT "Initial Organization" and select "Internal Org"

Verifications.Text: Initial Organization dropdown shows "Internal Org" as the selected value.
Dialog closes without displaying any error and a row for "New Backoffice User" with email "newboffice@test.local" is visible in the user grid.
Email inbox displays a new magic-link email destined for newboffice@test.local.
The new user (newboffice@test.local) is signed in successfully.
The user interface reflects the assigned role "Backoffice User".
